pour: Hold the button or the glass to pour, release to stop.
Aim for the green zone: the foam settles a little after pouring, so release just above it.
Each glass type has its own ideal level. Chain perfect glasses for a streak bonus.
Careful: if it overflows, the glass is lost!
barber: A client sits down with an order: check the ticket.
Pick the right tool, then perform the move on the client.
Be precise and fast: precision bonus, speed bonus and a x2 multiplier after 3 successes.
Wrong tool or impatient client: points lost.
beat: Tap the lane when the note crosses the line. Hold for long notes.
PERFECT or GOOD: keep going to build your combo and a multiplier up to x4.
findit: A Cutshop scene appears with a list of objects to find.
Tap each object on the list as soon as you spot it. Use the zoom if needed.
The faster you are, the more points you score. A scene without mistakes earns a bonus.
Avoid random taps: each mistake costs 10 points.
